entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about an order I placed a couple of months ago. I'd like to return a pair of cycling shoes.
I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have the order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-09B. The name is Alex Chen.
Thank you, Alex. I see the order here. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's a fit issue. I've used them a few times, but they're giving me terrible blisters on my heel. It's not a defect, they're well-made, but the shape just doesn't work for my foot. I've even tried adjusting the cleats to change the pressure points, but no luck.

I'm very sorry to hear the cycling shoes are causing blisters; I know how uncomfortable that can be. Getting the right fit is everything. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see they were delivered 62 days ago.
That sounds about right. I was hoping I could still get a refund.

Absolutely. Our policy allows for returns within 90 days, so you are well within the window. I can go ahead and process a full refund for you. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email right now.

That's great, I appreciate you taking care of the refund so quickly. Since I do plan on ordering a different model from your site and I've had to go through this bit of trouble, would it be possible to get a small discount code for my next purchase?

That's a reasonable request. I see here that you're a long-time VeloFit customer, and we certainly want to make sure you get into a pair of shoes that you love. As a thank you for your loyalty, I can add a 20% VIP discount to your account, which you can apply to your next order. How does that sound?
Wow, 20% is perfect. That more than makes up for it. Thank you very much, Isaac.

You are very welcome, Alex. The discount is now active on your account, and the return label is in your inbox. Once we receive the shoes, the refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that's all. You've been a great help.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a wonderful day.
